prompts.sokol:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one finished transparent 2D aircraft sprite for Canvas flight approval.
Reference image role: style and proportions reference ONLY the TOP TWO aircraft; ignore both bottom jets completely.
Create ONLY ONE aircraft: A graceful blue inline-engine WWII-era fighter, matching the TOP LEFT blue aircraft in the reference closely. Cobalt blue, ivory stripe, yellow spinner and wing tips. Long tapering nose, modest belly radiator, low closed canopy, thin rounded tapered wings. Preserve its beautiful proportions.
Match the reference's refined colorful 2D illustration, subtle cel shading, natural real-aircraft proportions, slim outline, appealing crisp colored shapes. Mildly stylized, mature, not a toy. Render normal thin propeller blades as a SUBTLE translucent spinning disk at the nose; do not make propeller an exaggerated focal point. 2–3 broad shading levels, matte paint, restrained surface details; eliminate dense panel lines, tiny rivets and glossy 3D rendering. Closed glass cockpit. No text, labels, UI, scenery, floor, ground shadow or background. Genuine alpha transparency. Aircraft silhouette must remain readable at 120px width.
